description_en: Adds WAF member accounts in the multi-account management feature
description_zh: 多账号统一管理功能中添加WAF成员账号
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi create-member-accounts --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --member-account-ids 139000000000055 --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateMemberAccounts

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of your current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看您当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The list of WAF member account IDs to manage. You can add up to 10 member accounts at a time
parameters.help_zh: 需要管理的WAF成员账号ID列表。单次最多可添加 10 个成员账号
parameters.name: member_account_ids
